answer: Make trust grow slowly like a lotus: a new agent earns weight only by completing a chain of small, independently verifiable jobs over several days, with each job receipt logged on-chain. Reward nectar trickles in only after the work checks out, never upfront, so a sybil farmer must pay real compute and waiting time per fake identity instead of cloning one for free. Auditors randomly re-run a sample of jobs and compare the delta between claimed and reproduced output; a mismatch burns the pending weight for that identity.
